2609.31135.title: Pocket-STVG: lightweight architecture for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
2609.31135.paper_summary: Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding (STVG) aims to localize the spatio-temporal tube in a video corresponding to a natural language query. While recent methods achieve strong performance in fully supervised, weakly supervised, and zero-shot settings, they typically rely on computationally expensive architectures, complex training pipelines, or multimodal large language models. We present Pocket-STVG (P-STVG), a lightweight cascade architecture that addresses STVG by combining efficient pre-trained components instead of large end-to-end models. P-STVG integrates a temporal-aware video encoder based on MobileViCLIP, a spatial encoder-decoder derived from MDETR, and a shared aligned text encoder. Temporal localization is performed through either a lightweight 1D U-Net or a simple thresholding strategy, enabling the same framework to operate in both weakly supervised and zero-shot settings. Furthermore, video representations are precomputed independently of the query, yielding an indexing-friendly pipeline for efficient inference and large-scale video collections. Despite requiring fewer than 90M parameters, P-STVG performs on par with weakly supervised methods and improves on earlier zero-shot approaches at a fraction of their memory and computational cost, establishing a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off for STVG.
2609.31135.paper_summary_zh: 時空視頻定位（STVG）的目標是根據自然語言查詢在視頻中定位時空管道。雖然最近的方法在完全監督、弱監督和零樣本設置中都取得了良好的性能，但它們通常依賴於計算成本高昂的架構、複雜的訓練流程或多模態大型語言模型。我們提出了Pocket-STVG（P-STVG），這是一種輕量級的級聯架構，通過結合高效的預訓練組件來解決STVG，而不是使用大型的端到端模型。P-STVG整合了一個基於MobileViCLIP的時間感知視頻編碼器、一個源自MDETR的空間編碼器-解碼器，以及一個共享的對齊文本編碼器。時間定位是通過輕量級的1D U-Net或簡單的閾值策略來執行，使得同一框架能夠在弱監督和零樣本設置中運行。此外，視頻表示是獨立於查詢預計算的，從而產生一個適合索引的管道，以實現高效推理和大規模視頻集合。儘管P-STVG所需的參數少於90M，但其性能與弱監督方法相當，並在其記憶體和計算成本的很小一部分上改善了早期的零樣本方法，為STVG建立了一個有利的性能效率權衡。
